title: SpeechEvent
description: Speech state transition and transcription event emitted by the voice pipeline.

node_id.description: Unique identifier of the emitting node

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the voice loop

cleaned_prompt.description: Sanitized and normalized prompt text passed to the LLM router

is_final.description: Whether this transcript chunk marks end-of-speech / final utterance
